name: Boat Lifestyle (Imagine Marketing)
description: India's leading audio & wearable brand. Known for affordable headphones, earbuds, and smartwatches. Revenue ₹3,500+ Cr with strong D2C presence.
purpose: Expansion into new product categories, international markets, and R&D investment for premium audio products.

name: Ather Energy
description: Premium electric scooter manufacturer (Ather 450X, 450S). Operates charging network (Ather Grid) across 100+ cities. Backed by Hero MotoCorp.
purpose: Setting up new manufacturing plant, expanding Ather Grid charging infra, R&D for new EV models, and working capital.

name: PhysicsWallah (PW)
description: India's largest ed-tech platform for competitive exam preparation. 100M+ registered students. Profitable unlike most ed-tech peers.
purpose: Offline center expansion, technology platform development, acquisitions, and brand building.

name: Tata Capital
description: NBFC arm of Tata Group offering consumer loans, wealth management, housing finance. AUM ₹1.5 lakh Cr. Part of Tata Sons restructuring.
purpose: Meet RBI listing mandate for large NBFCs, augment capital base for loan book growth, and comply with regulatory requirements.

name: BlueStone Jewellery
description: Online-first jewellery brand with 200+ retail stores. Combines e-commerce with physical retail. Backed by Accel, Ratan Tata.
purpose: Store expansion (target 500 stores), technology investment, inventory buildup, and brand marketing.

name: Vikran Engineering
description: Precision engineering company specializing in defense and aerospace components. Growing order book from government contracts.
purpose: Capacity expansion, new manufacturing facility, and working capital for defense order execution.

name: Nuvama Wealth Management
description: Wealth management and brokerage firm (formerly Edelweiss Wealth). Manages ₹50,000+ Cr AUM across HNI and ultra-HNI clients.
purpose: Growth capital for AUM expansion, technology platform upgrades, and potential acquisitions.

name: OYO (Oravel Stays)
description: World's leading hotel chain by room count. Operates in 35+ countries with 175,000+ hotels. Recently turned profitable.
purpose: Debt repayment, technology investment, international expansion, and general corporate purposes.

name: InMobi Technology
description: Global mobile advertising and data platform. Serves 1.6B+ devices. One of India's first unicorns. Profitable and growing.
purpose: Product development, international expansion, strategic acquisitions, and working capital.

name: Captain Fresh
description: B2B seafood and fresh produce supply chain platform. Uses AI for grading, pricing, and logistics optimization.
purpose: Cold chain infrastructure, technology development, and market expansion across India.
